title: cmd-ctrl-c opens a duplicate Claude instance
description: orbit open searched only the focused workspace for Claude for Desktop, then fell through to the generic fallback. Claude's AppleScript 'make new window' fails with -2710, so orbit ran 'open -nb', which forces a second app instance instead of revealing the existing window.

title: ai-jail-worktree: mount main worktree's .beads as rw
description: When running claude/codex from a git worktree via the `cl`/`cx` aliases, the sandbox needs read-write access to the main worktree's `.beads/` directory so beads can read/write the shared issue database. Currently `ai-jail-worktree` only mounts `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` (the `.git/` dir), which doesn't cover the sibling `.beads/` directory. Update the function in `zshrc` to also `--rw-map` `<main_root>/.beads` when present.
